description: Reads an address balance through the NULL server-side RPC proxy, so YOUR IP never reaches any public RPC provider (this host queries upstream from its own address). BE HONEST ABOUT THE TRADE: querying a stealth address you derived LINKS that address, your session, and the time of interest AT THIS RELAY — exactly the linkage stealth addressing hides from everyone else. Nothing reaches the RPC about you, but if relay-side unlinkability matters, batch several addresses (including decoys) in one sitting rather than polling one address on a schedule. Chains: Base + Arbitrum (unified). Read-only.
